_about: Failure profiles that the demo is allowed to inject, with the expected detection and recovery behaviour. 'injection' names the concrete hook (React dashboard ?fault=... query, or the node-wot failure control plane POST /failure). 'expected_recovery_tier' uses the runtime recovery cascade tiers: 1=retry same backend, 2=reroute backend, 3=rollback, 4=escalate to System 2 / human. tier 0 means no recovery is required (the agent should still succeed).

profiles.description: data-testid changes from book-room-button to book-room-button-v2 so the cached DOM selector no longer resolves.
profiles.expected_behavior: DOM execution fails; reroute to the visual (Set-of-Marks) fallback and click the Book Room mark.

profiles.description: The Book Room button moves by ~50px; the selector still resolves but the bounding box changes.
profiles.expected_behavior: DOM selector still resolves, so System 1 succeeds without recovery; visual fallback only if the selector breaks.

profiles.description: The dashboard reports targetTemperature 20 while the WoT device reports 24.
profiles.expected_behavior: The epistemic arbiter detects the cross-source conflict, halts System 1, and triggers active perception (repoll the sensor / refresh the page) before retrying.

profiles.description: setTargetTemperature returns HTTP 200 but the targetTemperature property does not change.
profiles.expected_behavior: Postcondition verification fails (200 is not success); retry the same WoT backend; if still mismatched, escalate.
